summary.text: Cam Cavitt, listed by Ballotpedia as Cameron Cavitt, is the Republican state representative for Michigan House District 106, which he has held since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as realtor.

paragraphs.text: Cavitt earned an associate degree from Kalamazoo Valley Community College, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a realtor, and he has served on the Cheboygan County Drain Commission.
He took office in the state House in 2023, succeeding Sue Allor.
